answer.headline: Revenue dropped severely beyond normal variation due to a sharp decline in average order value on mobile devices.
explanation: Revenue fell significantly compared to the prior week, driven by drops in sessions, conversion rate, and average order value.
Mobile devices accounted for a notable part of the decline, experiencing a steep drop in average order value starting mid-week.
Similar basket size drops appeared in Safari and iOS segments, pointing towards a checkout or cart pricing issue on mobile platforms.
answer.next_step: Investigate mobile checkout and cart pricing updates released around Dec 23 to see why order values collapsed on phones.
